products.name: The Written One
products.subtitle: A cake that is mostly a sentence
products.description: Pale blue, with the words set across the middle and whatever is on the bench piped around them — rosettes, hearts, silver pearls. It holds more lettering than anything else we make, and it ends up looking like whoever ordered it, which is the point. Quiet message, quiet cake. Loud one, and you get this.

plaque.note: Piped across the top in buttercream

products.name: The Heart
products.subtitle: Small enough to hold in one hand
products.description: Six inches, heart-shaped, and meant for two people and one evening. It is the cake people buy when there is no occasion at all, which is the reason we started making it.

plaque.note: Piped on the surface, two short lines at most

products.name: The Pressed Heart
products.subtitle: White on white, worked with a needle
products.description: The lace is pressed into set royal icing by hand and left entirely white. There is no good way to write on it, so this is the one cake here that goes out with the card doing all the talking.

products.name: Blossom
products.subtitle: Pale, with the first flowers of the year
products.description: One tier, finished in the palest blue we can mix, with whatever blossom is actually out that week set against it. In February that means something forced; in April it means the tree on Bartlett Street.

plaque.note: On a small iced plaque, set into the flowers

products.name: The Garden
products.subtitle: Cream, and a great deal of green
products.description: Swept cream buttercream under herbs and leaves — bay, mint, whatever is sturdy enough to last the afternoon. It photographs better than it has any right to, which is not why we make it.

plaque.note: On a plaque, tucked among the leaves

products.name: The Strawberry Tier
products.subtitle: Two tiers, barely iced, fruit on top
products.description: Scraped back so the sponge shows through, built in two tiers and loaded with strawberries and whatever flowers are in. It only exists between May and September, because the rest of the year the fruit is not worth putting on a cake.

plaque.note: On a plaque at the base of the top tier

products.name: Ombré
products.subtitle: Three tiers, and about ninety sugar roses
products.description: The roses are made one at a time, dried for two days and shaded from deep pink at the base to nearly white at the top. It is the longest job in the shop and the one we most like doing.

plaque.note: On a plaque between the first and second tier

products.name: The Rose Tier
products.subtitle: The biggest thing we will take on
products.description: Three tiers, garden roses in two colours, and a week of notice because the flowers are made before the cake is. Past this size we will tell you honestly to ask somebody with a bigger kitchen.

plaque.note: On a plaque at the base
